We're landing. Secure yourself.''"
"''Mesa trying. Itsa stucken.|Kharrus and Jar Jar Binks|}} '''Kharrus''' was a respected [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], representing his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A loyal supporter of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Kharrus became a highly skilled [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] and embarked on a number of missions on the Republic's behalf, often operating under perilous circumstances. At one point, he spent three [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] in [[Prisoner/Legends|captivity]] while on a ransom mission. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Kharrus was tasked with delivering one million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits']] worth of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], where the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]] of [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] was holding the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] hostage. Accompanied by a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] detail led by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Stone (clone trooper)/Legends|CC-5869]] of the [[Diplomatic Escort Group]], Kharrus was to [[Mission to Florrum/Legends|deliver]] the spice ransom and bring Dooku back to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for incarceration. On their approach to Florrum, Kharrus's [[Kharrus's Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was shot down by the pirate [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso's]] breakaway faction of the Ohnaka Gang, which sought to pilfer the payment of spice. Kharrus [[Death/Legends|died]] in the resulting crash, leaving his team under the command of its junior [[Junior Representative/Legends|representative]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]. Binks saw to it that the esteemed senator was buried and laid to rest near their crash site in the [[Doshar fields/Legends|Doshar fields]]. Kharrus's death sparked a [[Politics/Legends|political]] crisis that isolated Kinyen from the Republic and eventually led it to become a Separatist staging area. ==Biography== ===Senator of Kinyen=== {{Quote|The last time I went on one of these ransom missions, I spent three weeks in a ''dungeon''.|Kharrus|audio=KharrusDungeon-TGG.flac|}} [[File:Kharrus-TCWf.png|thumb|left|250px|Kharrus is present with Onaconda Farr when Jabba contacts Chancellor Palpatine.]] The [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Kharrus lived during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], hailing from [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]], his [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' He embarked into the realm of [[Politics/Legends|politics]] and eventually entered the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], which was [[Senate Building/Legends|based]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. As the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of Kinyen,[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine 20|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine'' 20]] Kharrus was beloved by his people.''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'' He became loyal to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and,{{CSWECite|II|214|Kharrus, Senator}} throughout his career, undertook numerous assignments as a Republic [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]]. While on a ransom mission, he was captured and [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] in a dungeon for three [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], a debacle that he never forgot. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in which the Republic was locked in pan-[[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Kharrus earned veteran status for his diplomatic service in frequently dangerous conditions,''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' being recognized for his lengthy senatorial career. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the war's first [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Kharrus was on Coruscant when the Republic mounted an [[Battle of Teth/Legends|operation]] to save [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], the son of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. By doing so, Palpatine hoped to gain favor with Jabba to negotiate for [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] access to the strategic [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] running through [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], which the Confederacy also coveted. Kharrus and Senator [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]][[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]{{SWE|characters|onacondafarr|Onaconda Farr}} were meeting with Palpatine in his [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|office]] in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] when the Supreme Chancellor received a transmission from Jabba. Establishing [[holograph]]ic communication, Palpatine assured Jabba that [[Jedi/Legends|members]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] were actively searching for Rotta, though Jabba reminded him that there would be no treaty if his son was not returned. The Jedi later rescued Rotta, ensuring the passage of the Republic's [[Hutt–Republic treaty/Legends|treaty]] with Jabba and the Hutts. ===Ransom delivery on Florrum=== {{Quote|We're under attack.''"
"''We've been betrayed.|One of the shuttle's clone pilots and Kharrus|}} [[File:StoneKharrusBinks-TGG.png|thumb|right|250px|Seated with Commander Stone, Kharrus tells Binks to secure himself for their landing.]] Later that year,''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]'' the Republic Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]] initiated a campaign to capture Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and thus ensure a quicker end to the war. Despite the Republic's efforts, the elusive [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] instead ended up being taken prisoner by the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]], a group of [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], the leader of the pirates, directly contacted the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]] and offered to consign the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] to Republic custody for a ransom of one million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], to be delivered in the form of [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. After [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] went to verify that the pirates were indeed holding Dooku, Kharrus was present with Palpatine, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] in the Supreme Chancellor's office when Kenobi and Skywalker [[Hologram/Legends|holographically]] reported back from Florrum. With the Jedi's confirmation that Dooku was being securely held, Palpatine personally dispatched Kharrus and Binks to Florrum to deliver the ransom of spice.{{TCW|Dooku Captured}} Once the Jedi had gained custody of Dooku, Kharrus and his team would help them escort the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] back to Coruscant. A [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of four [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard's]] [[Diplomatic Escort Group]]—under the command of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Stone (clone trooper)/Legends|CC-5869]], nicknamed "Stone"''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''—was assigned to Kharrus, who, as the senior senatorial representative, was made the diplomatic [[Envoy/Legends|envoy]] in charge of the [[Mission to Florrum/Legends|delivery mission]] to Florrum. The assignment itself promised to be the most important of his lengthy career. [[Mack/Legends|Mack]] and another [[Unidentified clone trooper pilot (Florrum)|clone pilot]] flew the diplomatic team to Florrum aboard a [[Kharrus's Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] with the heavy crates of spice. Once they arrived in the [[Florrum system/Legends|Florrum system]], Kharrus contacted Palpatine, who was in his office on Coruscant with Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and several [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] members, and informed him that they were due to land shortly. Kharrus stated that their signal would be strong enough to establish proper communications with Kenobi and Skywalker{{SW|url=video/the-gungan-general-episode-featurette|text="The Gungan General" Episode Featurette}} once they were on the surface. As they entered Florrum's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], Mack told Kharrus, Binks, and their [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to secure themselves for the landing, which they did, though Binks encountered trouble with operating the safety guard on his chair. Unbeknownst to Kharrus and the others, a breakaway faction of the Ohnaka Gang—overseen by Ohnaka's duplicitous [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]]—intended to intercept the spice ransom before it reached Ohnaka's [[Hondo's complex/Legends|stronghold]]. Falso's associate [[Barb Mentir/Legends|Barb Mentir]],{{TCW|The Gungan General|d=y}} flying a [[Unidentified Flarestar-class attack shuttle (Barb Mentir)/Legends|''Flarestar''-class attack shuttle]], assailed the Republic [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] from behind and opened [[Laser/Legends|fire]] on it, leading Kharrus to realize that they had been betrayed. A pair of [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedoes]] from Mentir's [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|craft]] compromised the Republic [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle's]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]], sending the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] straight for the surface. During their uncontrolled descent, Kharrus released the safety restraint on his chair long enough to help Binks into his own, mere [[Standard second|seconds]] before their craft crash-landed in Florrum's [[Doshar fields/Legends|Doshar fields]]. The impact disabled Kharrus's chair guard and ripped apart the shuttle, and the senator was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the resulting crash. Both of the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]] also perished, leaving only Binks, Stone, and the three other [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] with the spice shipment. In Kharrus's absence, Binks, being the ranking member of the Senate, was entrusted with command of the mission. Assisted by the squad's [[Unidentified Coruscant Guard sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], Binks buried Kharrus's body under a pile of rocks close to the crash site, leaving behind the senator's [[Kharrus's staff/Legends|staff]] as a mark for his grave. ===Legacy=== Kharrus's death sparked political tensions between his homeworld of Kinyen and the Gran colony world of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. Rival Gran from Malastare blocked the appointment of a replacement senator from Kinyen, alleging that Kinyen was affiliated with the Confederacy due to its relations with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Without Senate representation, Kinyen became isolated from the Republic and was thus pressured to join the Confederacy. As a result, Kharrus's homeworld eventually became an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] staging area for Separatist operations along the nearby [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]]. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Yousa find rest, Senator. Thosen with good in their heart always passen too soon. We be missing you, Senator.|Jar Jar Binks, laying Kharrus to rest on Florrum|}} [[File:Kharrus-TCW.png|thumb|left|160px|Kharrus was a trusted ally of Chancellor Palpatine.]] Standing 1.78 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, Kharrus had [[Color/Legends|pink]] skin and three green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], which offered him superior vision. He garnered enough political acumen to serve as a senator in the Republic Senate, over a career that became noted for its length. Like most Gran, Kharrus was deeply loyal and was willing to do anything for the greater good of the Republic. He became respected{{TCWA|set=Senator Kharrus}} as a seasoned diplomat and would barely blink an eye when asked to undertake perilous assignments for the Republic, coming to specialize in negotiations under extreme circumstances with the galaxy's more dangerous elements. A steadfast supporter of Chancellor Palpatine, Kharrus was a trusted ally of the Supreme Chancellor and was honored when tasked with delivering the spice ransom to Florrum, as capturing [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku and potentially ending the Clone Wars made the mission the most important one of the senator's career. During official events, Kharrus wore a formal set of white-and-blue [[Robe/Legends|robes]] that were equally dignified and flexible for any possible situations that could arise while he was in the field. He also carried with him an ancient [[Staff/Legends|staff]], which Jar Jar Binks used to mark his burial site on Florrum. Colleagues such as Binks were saddened by his death and believed that the Gran would be sorely missed. Binks did his best to honor the late senator's memory, negotiating with the pirates on Florrum on account of believing that it was what Kharrus would have done. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Of the interesting things in the episode, a small detail is that Senator Kharrus, who meets an unfortunate end, is carrying the headpiece of the Staff of Ra. And Jar Jar plants it on his grave.|Series Supervising Director [[Dave Filoni]]|{{SW|url=video/this-is-just-business|text=This is Just Business}}}} The character of Senator Kharrus was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. He first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|feature film]] that debuted the series on [[August 15]], [[2008]], though his appearance there was not verified until [[October]] [[2009]], with the publication of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1|''The Official Episode Guide: Season 1'']]. He was more prominently featured in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] episodes "[[Dooku Captured]]" and "[[The Gungan General]]," which aired respectively on [[January 2]]{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode011.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Dooku Captured}} and [[January 9]], 2009. He was given a speaking role in the latter episode, with vocal performance provided by actor [[Corey Burton]], the series' voice for Count Dooku. His staff was an [[Easter egg]] based on the [[W:c:indianajones:Headpiece to the Staff of Ra|headpiece of the Staff of Ra]], an artifact from the film [[Wikipedia:Raiders of the Lost Ark|''Raiders of the Lost Ark'']], produced by [[George Lucas]]. Besides being referenced in such material as ''The Official Episode Guide: Season 1'', [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles|''Visual Guide Ultimate Battles'']], and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia|''The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia'']], Kharrus also received an entry in the [[December]] 2008 ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which was the first publication to identify him by name following his unattributed appearance in ''The Clone Wars'' film. Kharrus appears as a playable character in the [[2011]] [[Canon|non-canon]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''. He is not featured in the "Story Mode" campaign of the level adapting "The Gungan General" but is instead made available for in-game purchase following completion of the level for use in the game's "Free Play" mode.''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' His character animation model has been reused in subsequent episodes of the television series, specifically for background characters in scenes featuring the Galactic Senate.{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}{{TCW|Senate Murders}} A canonical connection between Kharrus and the as-yet unnamed characters has not been established. ==Appearances==
